entities.name: Rill
entities.description: A resilient native survivor of Duskmourn on the Carnival's foraging team who joined the Cult of Valgavoth.

entities.name: City
entities.description: Rill's companion who revealed he served the Cult of Valgavoth and betrayed them.

entities.name: Sunset
entities.description: Rill's companion, later held by the cult.

entities.name: Cult of Valgavoth
entities.description: Cult serving Valgavoth that captured the survivors.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The plane, a House of horrors, where Rill lives.

entities.name: Niko
entities.description: Captured with the Wanderer and Nashi.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: Captured with Niko and the Wanderer.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: Betrayed Niko's group, sealing them in the room with the cultists.

entities.name: Wickerfolk
entities.description: Monster that ambushed Rill's foraging party.

events.summary: A Wickerfolk ambushes Rill, City and Sunset on a foraging mission, leaving Rill with a deep gash.
events.quote: They were ambushed by a Wickerfolk straying too close to the safe path

events.summary: City reveals Duskmourn is now hunting the humans and his allegiance to the Cult of Valgavoth, betraying Rill; Rill and the others are captured.
events.quote: City betrayed Rill and the others

events.summary: The wounded Rill gives in to the cultists' demands and agrees to become one of them.
events.quote: agreeing to become one of them

events.summary: Winter betrays Niko, the Wanderer and Nashi, sealing them in with the cultists, who knock them out with sedative dust.

relations.quote: revealing his allegiance to the Cult of Valgavoth
agreeing to become one of them
